lcc_sn: 人殺該隱<WH07014>、若<WH03588>須遭報<WH05358><WTH8714>七倍<WH07659>；那麼若殺拉麥<WH03929>，就須遭報七十<WH07657>七倍<WH07651>了！』
lcc_original: 人殺該隱、若須遭報七倍；那麼若殺拉麥，就須遭報七十七倍了！』
notes: WH03588 (כִּי, 'if/for') attaches to 若 in '若須遭報' rather than sentence-initial position; LCC restructures by fronting '人殺該隱', placing the conditional marker after the protasis subject
人, 須, 就須, 那麼 are LCC additions with no direct Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
Second 遭報 in LCC left untagged: Hebrew implies the verb in the second clause without repeating it, and UNV likewise omits SN on 必遭報
了 is a Chinese aspect particle added by LCC — unannotated
